## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A two-fascicle Esoteric *yoga* practice ritual manual by **Śubhakarasiṃha** ([善無畏](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%96%84%E7%84%A1%E7%95%8F)) for the *Uṣṇīṣa-vijaya* (*Zūnshèng fódǐng* — Victorious Buddha-Crown) practice. The text gives the elaborated *yoga-tantra* version of the *Uṣṇīṣa-vijaya* practice, integrating the *dhāraṇī*-recitation with the broader Esoteric *yoga*-mandala framework.

**Abstract**

Śubhakarasiṃha's two-fascicle ritual manual is one of the principal Táng Esoteric codifications of the Uṣṇīṣa-vijaya practice. Where Amoghavajra's later T972 ([KR6j0149](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0149)) gives the daily-practice recitation manual, Śubhakarasiṃha's T973 gives the more elaborate *yoga* practice for advanced practitioners. The translation dates from Śubhakarasiṃha's Cháng'ān period (716–735).
